itens.trecho: Um marco do cinema de terror. Este filme trata de um único tema: ataques de tubarões a humanos. Dirigido por Steven Spielberg e escrito por Peter Benchley e Carl Gottlieb, tem um elenco de actores onde sobressaem Roy Scheider, Robert Shaw e Richard Dreyfuss.

Jaws. A man eating shark is terrorising the holiday island of Amity. Police chief Martin Brody, shark hunter Quint and marine biologist Matt Hooper set sail in the hope of killing the great white monster.

Much like the shark itself, the movie starts slowly, deep down in the depths before coming to the surface to explode in pure sensationalism. Jaws is one of those rare exceptions where high-brow art meets fun entertainment. At the time of its making, however, simply keeping its head above water was the most the cast and crew were hoping for.
